name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Anchored info panel with 12 placements (top/bottom/left/right × start/center/end), optional title row with leading icon and close affordance, supporting text, and inline action buttons. Built on Radix Popover so the panel can hold interactive content — focus management, click-outside, ESC, and portaling come for free. Includes both composable primitives and a prop-driven SimpleTooltip wrapper. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 2380:1293 (Pantheon › Tooltip).
